title: TSMC Ramps 40nm Volume Production to Promote Innovation as Foundries Assume a Larger Role for $300 Billion Industry

passages.note: Main paragraphs 1 and 9, TSMC 40nmG and 40nm LP. The November announcement reports October product qualification and initial customer wafers entering production. These are downstream uses of immersion at 40 nm, distinct from 2004 feasibility at 90 nm.
